Contact our company for quality and professional assistance in legalizing your stay in Poland.

Offers.offer1_description: This is a document confirming the special status of a foreign citizen in Poland and allows them to stay in the country longer than with visas. This is a residence permit that allows for unlimited border crossings into Poland without obtaining a visa, as well as working and studying without additional permits.
Offers.offer1_chat1_answer: It grants the right to stay in the country continuously and officially work for a period of 1 to 3 years (depending on the duration of the issued decision).
Offers.offer1_chat2_question: What reasons may lead to the refusal of temporary residence in Poland?
Offers.offer1_chat2_answer: Incorrect or incomplete submission of documents, insufficient financial capability of the applicant to cover expenses during their stay, lack of confirmation of the legal purpose of stay, previous violations of visa or immigration legislation in Poland or the Schengen Area, threats to public safety.
Offers.offer2_description: Permanent residence (Pobyt stały) is a permit for permanent residence in Poland, which grants foreigners the right to live, work, and study indefinitely in the country. This status also allows for travel within the Schengen Area and access to some social rights.
Offers.offer2_chat1_question: What is the difference between pobyt stały and temporary residence?
Offers.offer2_chat1_answer: Pobyt stały grants the right to permanent residence without the need to extend the permit, while temporary residence is limited to a specific term and requires renewal.
Offers.offer2_chat2_question: Can I work in Poland with a permanent residence permit?
Offers.offer2_chat2_answer: Yes, a permanent residence permit grants the right to work in Poland without the need for additional work permits.
Offers.offer3_description: Obtaining Polish citizenship is a process through which foreigners can become citizens of Poland. This can be done in various ways, including naturalization, which requires living in Poland for a specified time, or by descent if one of the parents is a Polish citizen.
Offers.offer3_chat1_question: What conditions must be met to obtain Polish citizenship?
Offers.offer3_chat1_answer: To obtain Polish citizenship, one must meet certain requirements, including the period of residence in Poland, legal status of residence, knowledge of the Polish language, and awareness of Polish culture and history.
Offers.offer3_chat2_question: How long does the process of obtaining citizenship take?
Offers.offer3_chat2_answer: The entire process may take from several months to a few years, depending on the circumstances of the case and the type of application submitted.
Offers.offer4_description: A work permit is a document confirming the legal right of a foreigner to work in Poland. It is necessary for those who wish to work in various fields but do not have the right to do so based on other documents (e.g., residence permit).
Offers.offer4_chat1_question: What types of work permits are there in Poland?
Offers.offer4_chat1_answer: In Poland, there are several types of work permits, including type A, B, C, D, and E, depending on the form of employment and the nature of work.
Offers.offer4_chat2_question: How long does it take to issue a work permit?
Offers.offer4_chat2_answer: The time required for processing a work permit application is typically 1 to 3 months, but it can vary depending on the case.
Offers.offer5_description: Family reunification is a process by which foreigners can bring their family members to Poland. This can be done through various types of permits and visas, depending on the family relationships and residence status of the applicant.
Offers.offer5_chat1_question: Who can apply for family reunification?
Offers.offer5_chat1_answer: Family reunification can be applied for by those who hold a residence permit or have Polish citizenship and wish to bring their spouse, children, or other family members to Poland.
Offers.offer5_chat2_question: What documents are needed for family reunification?
Offers.offer5_chat2_answer: Required documents typically include proof of family relationship, legal residence in Poland, and sufficient financial means to support family members.
Offers.offer6_title: Preparing documents for the Polish Card
Offers.offer6_description: The Polish Card (Karta Polaka) is a document that confirms a person's Polish origin and provides specific privileges, including the right to reside and work in Poland.
Offers.offer6_chat1_question: What are the benefits of having a Polish Card?
Offers.offer6_chat1_answer: The Polish Card grants the right to apply for a residence permit, work, and study in Poland, as well as various social benefits and discounts.
Offers.offer6_chat2_question: How can I apply for a Polish Card?
Offers.offer6_chat2_answer: To apply for a Polish Card, one must submit an application along with the required documents to a consulate or appropriate authorities in Poland.
Offers.offer7_description: Company registration in Poland is a process through which entrepreneurs can establish their business and operate legally in the Polish market. It requires preparing the necessary documents and meeting specific legal requirements.
Offers.offer7_chat1_question: What documents are required for company registration in Poland?
Offers.offer7_chat1_answer: The required documents usually include the company's articles of association, identification documents of the founders, and other necessary permits depending on the business type.
Offers.offer7_chat2_question: How long does it take to register a company in Poland?
Offers.offer7_chat2_answer: The process of registering a company in Poland can take from several days to several weeks, depending on the complexity of the case and the completeness of documents.
Offers.offer8_description: Marriage in Poland can be registered by foreigners under specific conditions. This process includes preparing the necessary documents, obtaining required permits, and complying with Polish law regarding marriage.
Offers.offer8_chat1_question: What documents are required to marry in Poland?
Offers.offer8_chat1_answer: To marry in Poland, you usually need to provide identification documents, proof of legal residence, and certificates confirming the ability to marry.
Offers.offer8_chat2_question: Is it necessary to register a marriage at the consulate?
Offers.offer8_chat2_answer: It is not necessary to register a marriage at the consulate if the marriage takes place in Poland; however, it is recommended to inform the consulate of the marriage for potential future legal matters.
Offers.offer9_description: Real estate services in Poland include assistance with buying, selling, renting properties, as well as legal support in matters related to real estate transactions.
Offers.offer9_chat1_question: What documents are needed for purchasing real estate in Poland?
Offers.offer9_chat1_answer: To purchase real estate in Poland, you will typically need proof of identity, residence documents, and financial documents confirming the ability to make the purchase.
Offers.offer9_chat2_question: How can I ensure a safe real estate transaction in Poland?
Offers.offer9_chat2_answer: To ensure a safe transaction, it is recommended to consult a lawyer who specializes in real estate, verify the legitimacy of the seller, and conduct thorough due diligence on the property.
Offers.offer10_description: Other services may include assistance with obtaining various types of documents, legal advice, and support in navigating the local bureaucracy for foreigners.
Offers.offer10_chat1_question: What other services can I expect?
Offers.offer10_chat1_answer: You can expect assistance with residence documents, work permits, legal consultations, and advice on various legal matters in Poland.
Offers.offer10_chat2_answer: You can contact our specialists through our website, and they will provide you with the necessary assistance tailored to your needs.
